47051.page_note: Priority Ambulance says it is the exclusive 911 ambulance provider for Franklin County. The state also records Grundy EMS, based in Sewanee, as a primary 911 provider in the county. Which parts of the county each one answers is not yet confirmed.

47185.page_note: White County EMS is the county's only licensed ambulance service and responds to 911 calls; a source stating that it transports 911 patients has not yet been found.

47159.page_note: Smith County Ambulance Service is the only ambulance service licensed in the county. The Smith County Rescue Squad also reports EMS crews moving patients; which agency carries 911 patients to hospital is not yet confirmed.

47007.page_note: Bledsoe County EMS is the only ambulance service licensed in the county; a current source stating that it answers 911 calls and transports patients has not yet been found.
